dialogue: “Say it again, but mean it this time.”
“If you leave now, I won’t stop you.”
description: The room smelled like rain and unfinished sentences.
A single light stayed on in the window like a dare.
The silence was the kind that had teeth.
internal: You realize too late that you’ve been hoping the whole time.
It’s not fear exactly. It’s recognition.
You tell yourself it doesn’t matter, and that’s how you know it does.
